items.title: A finite ring map is of finite type, and a finitely presented module structure gives finite presentation
items.author: The Stacks Project Authors
items.source_version: Stacks Project git a04446e57ec1 (2026-07-28); file algebra.tex; corpus local snapshot 20261012
items.difficulty_reason: The lemma states that a finite ring map is of finite type, and that finite presentation as a module implies finite presentation as an algebra (statement lines 888-896). The proof does not invoke general presentation theory: it observes that module generators are algebra generators and then writes an explicit polynomial presentation from the module relations, the expression of the unit and the structure constants (proof lines 898-912). Producing that explicit presentation is what settles the second assertion. H2.
